## 简体中文

### 亮点

- 新增托管的 WireGuard-over-wstunnel 客户端，并简化隧道 DNS、端点和高级设置。
- 新增明确的订阅保存并暂存流程、待重启反馈，以及订阅更新和托管核心重启确认。
- 安全重装时保留托管配置，并区分常规安装与快照恢复。

### 修复

- 编译私有访问路由时保留用户维护的原生 DNS 覆盖，避免生成的 WireGuard 和 DDNS 条目在多次渲染间累积。
- 在原操作通知中报告托管核心重启失败，包括失败阶段、底层错误、失败部署和自动回滚目标。
- 持久化最近一次运行失败，使上一份健康配置恢复后仍能看到失败信息。
- 确保对话框位于视口内，设置保存时不触发密码存储提示，允许关闭密码警告，并稳定高级隧道编辑。

### 维护

- 拆分超大应用、编译器、UI、站点、CLI 和平台模块，不改变其公开契约。
- 加强仓库规则，要求提交聚焦且可独立验证。

- [完整更新记录](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v0.5.2...v0.6.0)

## English

### Highlights

- Add managed WireGuard-over-wstunnel clients and simplify tunnel DNS, endpoint, and advanced settings.
- Add an explicit subscription save-and-stage flow, pending-restart feedback, and confirmations for subscription updates and managed-core restarts.
- Preserve managed configuration during safe reinstall and separate normal installation from snapshot restore.

### Fixes

- Preserve user-owned native DNS overrides while compiling private-access routes, preventing generated WireGuard and DDNS entries from accumulating across renders.
- Report managed-core restart failures in the original action notice, including the failure stage, underlying error, failed deployment, and automatic rollback target.
- Persist the latest runtime failure so it remains visible after the previous healthy configuration has been restored.
- Keep dialogs inside the viewport, prevent settings saves from prompting password storage, allow the password warning to be dismissed, and stabilize advanced tunnel editing.

### Maintenance

- Split oversized application, compiler, UI, site, CLI, and platform modules without changing their public contracts.
- Strengthen repository rules for focused, independently verifiable commits.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v0.5.2...v0.6.0
